coverage: Full-Year 2026 + Full-Year 2027 across USD, GBP, EUR, JPY, AUD, CAD (all 6 central banks >= 8 meetings/yr)
sources: federalreserve.gov — FOMC 2026 confirmed & 2027 tentative rate decisions (14:00 ET) + Press Conferences (14:30 ET)
bls.gov — US Employment Situation (NFP), CPI, and PPI 2026-2027 official release schedules (08:30 ET)
census.gov — US Advance Monthly Sales for Retail and Food Services 2026-2027 schedules (08:30 ET)
bea.gov — US GDP (Advance/2nd/3rd) & Personal Income and Outlays (Core PCE) 2026-2027 schedules (08:30 ET)
bankofengland.co.uk — BoE MPC Bank Rate 2026-2027 official schedule (12:00 London)
ons.gov.uk — UK Consumer Price Inflation (CPI) 2026-2027 official release calendar (07:00 London)
ecb.europa.eu — ECB Governing Council Monetary Policy Decisions (14:15 Frankfurt) + Press Conferences (14:45 Frankfurt) 2026-2027
boj.or.jp — BoJ Monetary Policy Meetings 2026-2027 official dates (release time unfixed ~11:30-12:30 JST; anchored 12:00 JST / 03:00 UTC EST03UTC)
rba.gov.au — RBA Monetary Policy Board cash rate decisions 2026-2027 official schedule (14:30 Australia/Sydney)
bankofcanada.ca — Bank of Canada policy interest rate announcements 2026-2027 official schedule (09:45 America/Toronto)
notes: Frozen red_news_official_2018_2024.json (224 Dev rows) and red_news_official_2025_2026.json (31 2025 + 32 2026 USD rows) remain untouched.
FOMC 2027 dates carry _TENTATIVE because Federal Reserve lists 2027 meetings as tentative; Oct 27 2027 is a monetary policy strategy meeting.
BoJ MPM dates are official, but announcement minute varies (~11:30-12:30 JST / 02:30-03:30 UTC), so tagged _EST03UTC.

BEA co-releases monthly Personal Income & Outlays (Core PCE) and GDP estimates at 08:30 ET; simultaneous BLS PPI + Census Retail Sales (2027-10-15, 2027-12-15) are deduplicated per (utc_ts, ccy) by build_red_news_calendar.py.
